title: Software Studio

input.title: Describe the software you want to create
input.placeholder: Example: Build a SaaS finance dashboard for indie founders that imports Stripe and bank data, then analyzes revenue, costs, churn, and cash-flow risk.

flow.title: Software Development Flow

figma.tokenPlaceholder: Paste a token starting with figd_
figma.tokenHelp: How to get an access token?
figma.connectFirst: Connect Figma before pasting a link.

figma.exportDesc: Generates a one-time pairing code. Enter it in the Figma plugin to rebuild this design as layers.

figma.sliceStarted: Smart slicing started — grab the pairing code here once it finishes
figma.pluginHint: Run the "AI Creative Studio Importer" plugin in the Figma desktop app, enter your backend URL and this pairing code to import.
